tagline: Neogen Corporation develops, manufactures and markets a diverse line of products and services dedicated to food and animal safety.
hero_kpi_rationale: Gross margin declining reflecting operational challenges: volume decline, manufacturing cost increases and inventory write-downs, partially offset by price increases and product mix improvement

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.description: Gross margin is a key profitability indicator for the company, expressed as a percentage of revenue
kpis.signal: Gross margin declined 3.1 points due to volume decline, manufacturing cost increases and elevated inventory write-downs

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.description: Neogen's total revenue, representing combined sales from Food Safety and Animal Safety segments
kpis.signal: Revenue declined $29.6M due to foreign exchange impact (-$24.3M) and underlying operational weakness

kpis.name: Operating Expenses
kpis.explanation: Total operating expenses including sales and marketing, administrative, and R&D
kpis.description: Total operating expenses comprising sales and marketing ($183.8M), administrative ($218.2M), goodwill impairment ($1,059.3M) and R&D ($21.1M)
kpis.signal: The substantial increase is primarily driven by a goodwill impairment charge of $1,059.3 million recorded in FY2025

kpis.name: Research and Development
kpis.description: Research and development expenditures, a key indicator of the company's innovation and product development
kpis.signal: R&D expenses declined due to reductions in contract services and salary costs, benefiting from 3M acquisition synergies

kpis.name: Service Revenue
kpis.description: Service revenue primarily composed of genomics services provided to livestock production and companion animal markets
kpis.signal: Service revenue declined $5.1M due to intentional business attrition and companion animal market weakness, partially offset by livestock market growth

kpis.name: International Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue generated by Neogen's international operations, representing 50.2% of consolidated revenue
kpis.signal: International revenue declined primarily due to foreign exchange headwind of $24.3M, partially offset by sales increases in Latin America and Europe

kpis.name: Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Revenue of $0.895B in the most recent fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of -$1.092B in the most recent fiscal year (FY2025).

risks.title: Material weakness in financial controls
risks.score_rationale: The report explicitly mentions material weaknesses in control activities and financial reporting communication, confirmed by external auditor BDO. The language is categorical ("not effective") and represents an existential risk to financial statement reliability. This category is weighted at maximum due to direct impact on compliance and market confidence.

risks.title: Foreign exchange risk on international revenue
risks.score_rationale: International revenue represents 50.2% of total, and a 10% currency depreciation would result in a $44.9M loss. The risk is quantified and recurring, with strong language intensity ("adversely affected"). Macro category is heavily weighted given strong international exposure.

risks.title: Variable interest rate risk
risks.score_rationale: 38.9% of debt is variable-rate, and a 75 bp increase would cost $2.6M. The risk is measured and partially hedged through a swap. The language is technical but not urgent, and hedging mitigates the risk. Medium weighting for capital risk.

risks.title: IT general control deficiencies
risks.score_rationale: Weaknesses in user access and IT change management affecting financial processes. These deficiencies rendered manual controls ineffective. Although partially remediated, they persist in overall assessment. Technical but precise language, cybersecurity category heavily weighted for an IT-facing company.

risks.title: Issues in accrual close-out provisions
risks.score_rationale: Material weakness identified in invoice accrual close-outs, impacting accuracy of charges and fixed assets. Repeated over multiple fiscal years, although remediation measures are underway. Firm language ("material weakness"), with direct impact on financial statements. Industrial category heavily weighted.

risks.title: Insufficient internal communication on controls
risks.score_rationale: Management did not properly communicate control responsibilities, nor maintain necessary documentation. This contributes to overall material weakness. Mentioned by external auditor, clear and concerning language. Industrial category, high impact on governance.
